newsitem.title: USA: Conn. state Rep. arrested on bribe charge.
newsitem.headline: Conn. state Rep. arrested on bribe charge.

text.p: Police Wednesday arrested Donnie R. Sellers, a police officer and state representative from Norwalk, Conn., on a charge of accepting a bribe, Connecticut's Chief State's Attorney John M. Bailey said.
Sellers, 52, is accused of accepting a bribe from an undercover federal agent in exchange for his help in obtaining a pistol permit.
He is expected to enter a plea when he is arraigned in superior court on Dec. 27.
Another legislator, Hartford state Rep. Edwin Garcia, was arrested on a similar charge earlier this month. Garcia's case is pending in the superior court.
The arrest of Sellers stemmed from a year-long probe that ended with the recent arrests of 10 people on charges linked to Food Stamp fraud, Bailey said.
